view.name: Article reader
view.description: Full-text article reader with title, date, feed/source/bookmark/like/markdown action chips, an AI summary callout and the article body, plus a floating chat button.

regions.label: Minimal header with only a back chevron button
H1 title, date, and a row of outlined chip buttons: feed name 'Go Blog', 'Source Article' external link, bookmark, like (pressed), Markdown export
Grey callout with blue left rule: one-sentence summary plus bullet points, truncated with 'Read more'/'Show less' toggle
Long-form article: blue H2 section headings, paragraphs, inline code, syntax-highlighted Go code blocks, embedded trace-viewer screenshots
Fixed circular blue chat button in bottom-right corner

evidence.note: Reader view of a feed item, with bookmark and Markdown export buttons

evidence.quote: Flight recorder provides always-on execution tracing with minimal overhead for production debugging.
evidence.note: Summary callout at the top of the article; expands in place with Read more / Show less
Continuous-scroll long-form text in a narrow ~592px column
Thumbs-up toggle button, aria-pressed, filled blue when active; no count shown

patterns.rationale: Only the floating 'Chat' launcher button is visible in the capture; clicking it on the live copy did not show a chat panel, so I couldn't confirm it is an AI conversation about the article.

evidence.note: Summary box is probably machine-generated but has no AI label or badge
A single truncation toggle, not stacked expandable sections

structure.layout: single centered reading column (~592px) under a minimal back-button header, with a fixed floating chat button; there is no sidebar or navigation

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif system stack (renders as Liberation Sans/Arial-like) for the title, headings and body; Noto Sans for the app chrome (back and chat buttons); ui-monospace for inline code and code blocks, which use GitHub-light syntax colors
aesthetics.typeScale: 28px/700 H1, 22px/700 blue H2s, 16px body with a generous ~1.8 line-height, 14px monospace code, 13px meta chips, 12px Read more link

notes: Reader view of an article in the Oksskolten RSS reader. The look is very plain: white page, one 592px column, near-black text, and blue (#2563eb) used for the H2 section headings, links, the active like button, the summary's left rule and the round chat FAB. The summary callout (#f7f7f7 fill, 4px blue left border) is cut off after two bullets and expands in place. The metadata action row uses small outlined chips (1px #e5e7eb border, 4px radius, 13px grey text); the bookmark, like and Markdown-export chips are icon-only, with an 'M↓' glyph for export. Code blocks are light grey with GitHub-style syntax colors and scroll horizontally. An empty Sonner toaster region ('Notifications alt+T') is in the DOM.
